question: Who is entranced by the neighbouring farmhouse named Wuthering Heights?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As mentioned in the **2nd** and **3rd** sentences of the passage, **Mr. Lockwood **is the character who rents Thrushcross Grange from Heathcliff and becomes intrigued by the neighbouring farmhouse, Wuthering Heights.

Therefore, the correct answer is ***"Mr. Lockwood".*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Entranced (मन्त्रमुग्ध) **- Filled with delight, wonder, or enchantment.

 
 
• **Example: **The audience was entranced by her beautiful performance on stage.
